semantics.sample: Sample all eight input bits at every rising clock edge.
semantics.equation: After rising edge n, pedge[i] = (sample[n-1][i] == 0) and (sample[n][i] == 1).
semantics.output_timing: Registered output is visible during the cycle following the sampling edge detecting the transition; holds between rising edges. No additional delay stage.
semantics.history: Store the current sampled input for comparison at the next rising edge.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified.
semantics.initialization: No initial values specified; history and output may be unknown before sufficient known samples. No forced initialization.
semantics.independence: Each bit is detected independently; held highs and falling transitions produce zero.

numeric.interpretation: Eight independent Boolean signals indexed 7 through 0.

verification.oracle: Independent per-bit comparisons of previous and current sampled values, evaluated after nonblocking updates.
verification.startup: Establish known input history with one sample before checking outputs.
coverage: each independent bit rise and fall
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; matching vvp; finite command and testbench timeouts.
verification.scope: Independent development test only, no official evaluation or synthesis.

specification_ambiguities.resolution: Registered detection of the current sample versus the previous sample is visible immediately after the detecting rising edge for the following cycle.
